SELECT caller_symbol_id, usage FROM (
  SELECT caller_symbol_id, 'direct' AS usage
  FROM code.call_edges
  WHERE caller_symbol_id IN (
    SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE name = 'get_renderable' AND file_id IN (
      SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'progress' AND package = 'rich'
    )
  )
  AND callee_symbol_id IN (
    SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE name = 'get_renderable'
  )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT caller_symbol_id, 'callback' AS usage
  FROM code.call_edges
  WHERE callee_symbol_id IN (
    SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE name = 'get_renderable'
  )
  AND passes_as_callback = TRUE
) sub
ORDER BY caller_symbol_id, usage
